NOTICE TO ALL PROSPECTIVE PARTICIPANTS OF DIPLOMA IN EDUCATION LEADERSHIP &
MANAGEMENT PROGRAMME PHASE 10

SUBJECT: ANNOUNCEMENT OF COURSE REGISTRATION

This is to inform all prospective trainees wishing to undertake the Diploma in Education
Leadership and Management Course (Phase 10) that the registration process is ongoing. The
Course and registration details are as follows: ~

1. The Course is undertaken by those trained as professional teachers both in management
and those aspiring for senior positions;

is)

The course entails éight (8) modules plus a project paper;

The course duration is one (1) year;

ad

Course examinations are administered leading to a diploma in Education Leadership and
Management;

5. Training will commence in July, 2022 on a date that will be communicated to you later;

6. The Diploma in Education Leadership and management programme is delivered through a
blended approach (Online and face to face).

7. All prospective participants can register by paying application fee of Kshs.1,000/=
through KEMI Paybill/Business No.971900, for Account No. enter D10 followed by your
work station County Code and then your TSC No. (D10/County Code/TSC No.) NB: In case
you do not have a TSC No. enter your PF or ID No. Attached, see a list of the County Codes;
and

8. Total Fees is Ksh.33,000/= inclusive of Kshs.1,000/= application fee. Tuition fee
(Kshs.32,000/=) will be paid in eight (8) installments at Kshs.4000/= per month
commencing July, 2022.

DR. MAURICE ODONDO
Ag. DIRECTOR
